svg.title: Schematic: understanding often builds before many spoken words
svg.desc: Side-by-side bands for receptive understanding and expressive talking, with an arrow showing typical direction of growth. Not norms for any one child.
svg.text: Many children follow directions or respond to names before strangers hear clear words.
Looks when named, follows familiar routines, points to pictures when asked
Often grows on an earlier track than long sentences
Babble, first words, longer phrases - visible to grandparents and passers-by
Can lag understanding without meaning a child is not listening
Group patterns only. Your pediatrician or SLP looks at the whole picture - not this graphic alone.
